3	# mongoose-server
4	
5	**Demonstrates:** a Mongoose server routing events through a handler (file feed → processor → file sink) with the admin web console, performance monitoring.
6	
7	A Mongoose server, generated by the [Fluxtion project starter](https://fluxtion-playground.dev/start).
8	
9	## Build & run
10	
11	```bash
12	./mvnw package
13	```
14	
15	
16	No command-line launcher was requested. Regenerate with the run-script option enabled, or use the included IntelliJ MongooseMain run configuration.
17	
18	Requires **JDK 21+**. **Use the supplied run configuration** — agrona needs JVM access flags
19	that a jar manifest does not grant, so a plain `java -jar` fails with `IllegalAccessError`
20	even though the manifest carries `Add-Opens`. Running **MongooseMain** from IntelliJ uses the
21	included run configuration, which sets the same flags.
22	
23	Web admin console: **http://127.0.0.1:8181**.
24	
25	## What's here
26	
27	- `config/server-config.yml` — the deployment descriptor (feeds, sinks, processor, services).
28	- `MyProcessor` — an `ObjectEventHandlerNode` that sees every broadcast event.
29	- `MongooseMain` — boots the server from the descriptor.
30	- `data/input.txt` — sample CSV rows (symbol,price,volume) the file feed reads on boot.
31	
32	- `ServerSmokeTest` — boots the server in-process via `MongooseTestHarness`.
33	
34	Default wiring: a file feed (`data/input.txt`) → `MyProcessor` → a file sink
35	(`data/output.txt`), with performance monitoring and the web console on.
36	
37	## Versions
38	
39	| Component | Version |
40	|---|---|
41	| mongoose | 1.0.29 |
42	| mongoose-plugins | 1.0.43 |
43

10	
11	Events whose relative order matters must share a supported ordered input route or an explicit upstream sequencer. Independent feeds do not promise deterministic interleaving. Inspect each selected connector and read strategy in the descriptor before running.
12

16	| Stop/restart (launcher not supplied) | Process and in-memory objects | Persistent connector positions and files depend on the selected connector; restart is not a promised rewind |

A publisher may advance a shared cache read pointer after dispatch: late subscribers do not receive an already-consumed prefix. Do not assume a cache is a rereadable buffer. No replay recorder is enabled by analyser support.

22	
23	Capture is not enabled by this project configuration. No audit export is promised. Enable a supported capture service explicitly before recording.
24	The effective descriptor below names the configured directory (relative to the host working directory), backend, roll size, retention and processor auto-start where enabled. Installation alone is not per-processor recording. Retention may remove earlier evidence; preserve an export before cleanup. Capture storage and analyser-readable YAML/JSONL exports are different artifacts.

26	```yaml
27	# Mongoose server descriptor — generated by the Fluxtion project starter.
28	# Boots via MongooseMain (MongooseServer.bootServer). Each feed/handler runs on the
29	# agent thread named by its agentName, looping with the configured idleStrategy.
30	
31	# Event handlers — your processor(s), grouped by the agent thread they run on.
32	eventHandlers:
33	  - agentName: processor-agent
34	    eventHandlers:
35	      myProcessor:
36	        customHandler: !!com.example.myapp.MyProcessor {}
37	
38	# Agent threads — long-running cooperative workers; each loops with an idle strategy
39	# (and optional CPU-core pin). Feeds/handlers above reference these by agentName.
40	agentThreads:
41	  - agentName: processor-agent
42	    idleStrategy: !!org.agrona.concurrent.SleepingMillisIdleStrategy {}
43	
44	  - agentName: feeds-agent
45	    idleStrategy: !!org.agrona.concurrent.SleepingMillisIdleStrategy {}
46	
47	# Event feeds — inbound sources. Each runs on its agentName thread; broadcast fans
48	# every event out to all processors on that agent.
49	eventFeeds:
50	  - name: input
51	    instance: !!com.telamin.mongoose.connector.file.FileEventSource
52	      filename: data/input.txt
53	      readStrategy: EARLIEST
54	    broadcast: true
55	    agentName: feeds-agent
56	
57	# Event sinks — outbound destinations processors publish to.
58	eventSinks:
59	  - name: output
60	    instance: !!com.telamin.mongoose.connector.file.FileMessageSink
61	      filename: data/output.txt
62	
63	# Performance monitoring — per-node counters + optional Chronicle-backed audit capture
64	# (records every event for deterministic replay via the admin console / visualiser).
65	performanceMonitoring:
66	  enabled: true
67	  counterBufferKb: 256
68	  latencyHistograms: true
69	  auditCapture:
70	    enabled: false
71	
72	# Services — shared singletons (admin console, server control, registries, caches…).
73	services:
74	  - name: adminCommandRegistry
75	    serviceClass: com.telamin.mongoose.service.admin.AdminCommandRegistry
76	    service: !!com.telamin.mongoose.service.admin.impl.AdminCommandProcessor {}
77	
78	  - name: serverAdmin
79	    service: !!com.telamin.mongoose.service.servercontrol.MongooseServerAdmin {}
80	
81	  - name: adminWebService
82	    service: !!com.telamin.mongoose.plugin.svc.adminweb.WebAdminService
83	      host: 127.0.0.1
84	      listenPort: 8181
85
